crisistrends_{variant}.long_name: Monthly count of Crisis Text Line conversations tagged {variant.short_name}
crisistrends_{variant}.short_description: Number of Crisis Text Line conversations in the month tagged with this topic. A conversation can carry more than one tag, so tag columns overlap and don't sum to a total.
crisistrends_{variant}.long_description: Monthly count of Crisis Text Line text/chat conversations tagged with this topic, by state ("Missing" if not reported) and age group ("Missing" if not reported). Conversations can have multiple tags. A conversation with multiple topics is counted once in each corresponding column. National and "Overall" age rows also include conversations where state or age was not reported, so they are not the sum of the state-level or age-specific rows.
crisistrends_{variant}.statement: In {location}, there were {value} Crisis Text Line conversations tagged {variant.short_name} in {time}.

crisistrends_n_tagged.long_name: Monthly count of Crisis Text Line conversations with at least one issue tag recorded
crisistrends_n_tagged.short_description: Number of Crisis Text Line conversations in the month with at least one issue tag recorded, counted once per conversation no matter how many tags it carries.
crisistrends_n_tagged.long_description: Monthly count of Crisis Text Line text/chat conversations with at least one issue_tags value recorded, by state ("Missing" if not reported) and age group ("Missing" if not reported). Unlike the per-topic crisistrends_<tag> columns, a conversation with multiple tags is counted only once here, making this the correct denominator for a topic's share of tagged conversations. Includes conversations tagged only with a topic CTL tracks internally but doesn't surface as its own crisistrends_<tag> column (e.g. Racism, School), so this total can exceed the dedup sum across the surfaced topic columns.
crisistrends_n_tagged.statement: In {location}, {value} Crisis Text Line conversations in {time} had at least one issue tag recorded.

crisistrends_total.long_name: Monthly count of all Crisis Text Line conversations, tagged or not
crisistrends_total.short_description: Total number of Crisis Text Line conversations in the month, whether or not they carry an issue tag.
crisistrends_total.long_description: Monthly count of all Crisis Text Line text/chat conversations, by state ("Missing" if not reported) and age group ("Missing" if not reported), including both tagged and untagged conversations. This is the overall denominator; there is no separate column for untagged conversations alone.
crisistrends_total.statement: In {location}, there were {value} total Crisis Text Line conversations in {time}.

ctl_crisistrends.name: Crisis Text Line's Crisis Trends
ctl_crisistrends.description: Crisis Text Line is a nonprofit organization that provides free, 24/7, confidential text-based mental health support and crisis intervention in both English and Spanish for anyone in the United States and Puerto Rico. Crisis Text Line has unique insight into the mental health crisis in the United States, and believe it is their duty to share aggregate, actionable insights that shape policy, improve practice, and advance mental health and wellbeing for people globally. This dataset contains de-identified conversation metrics, aggregated to unique combinations of month, issue tags, service, age, and state. Each conversation may carry multiple issue tags, so per-tag counts overlap. Note that these data are not expected to exactly match those on crisistrends.org because Crisis Trends includes conversations that are purposefully excluded from this data set due to data sharing restrictions.
ctl_crisistrends.restrictions: Attribution required. Cite as: Crisis Text Line (2026). Crisis Trends. https://crisistrends.org/ (date accessed).
